Name: More Coffee
Author: Yuzu17
Description:
[b][i][size=4][font=sans-serif][color=#ffff00]UPDATE on 9/30/2026[/color]

[url=https://www.curseforge.com/linkout?remoteUrl=https%253a%252f%252fwww.nexusmods.com%252fstardewvalley%252fmods%252f36813][color=#ff7700][u]Scale Up Unofficial [/u][/color][/url][color=#ffff00]support is NOW included in this mod.[/color]
[color=#ffff00]PLEASE REMOVE Sprite In Detail from your mods folder.[/color]
[color=#ffff00]Those two conflict. [/color][/font][/size][/i][/b]


[b][i][color=#f4cccc][size=4][font=sans-serif]More Coffee[/font][/size][/color][/i][/b]
More Coffee adds 20 new coffee recipes with detailed 96px food icons.
[color=#00ffff][b]Supports Cornucopia, Wildflour, SVE, RSV.[/b][/color]
Each recipe has its own ingredients, price, energy recovery, buffs, and NPC gift tastes.


[b][i][color=#ea9999][size=4][font=sans-serif]Antique Roaster[/font][/size][/color][/i][/b]
First, craft the roaster from the crafting menu. 
Place five coffee beans inside to make one bag of Roasted Coffee Beans.


[color=#ea9999][size=4][font=sans-serif][b][i]Secret Woods Spring Water[/i][/b][/font][/size][/color]
First, craft an Empty Springwater Bottle. You can find it under “Other” in the crafting menu.
Hold the empty bottle and go to the Secret Woods. You can collect water from any pond or river within the Secret Woods.
One empty bottle gives you five bottles of Secret Woods Spring Water.



[b][i][color=#f4cccc][size=4][font=sans-serif]Flexible Ingredients[/font][/size][/color][/i][/b]
Many recipes use flexible ingredient categories instead of requiring one specific item.

[b]For example:[/b]

[list]
[*]Any berry[/*]
[*]Any apple[/*]
[*]Any banana[/*]
[*]Any avocado[/*]
[*]Any edible mushroom[/*]
[*]Any milk, egg, or cheese[/*]
[*]Any herb[/*]
[*]Any butter or nut butter[/*]
[/list]This allows ingredients from compatible crop and artisan mods to be used in the recipes.


[b][i][color=#f4cccc][size=4][font=sans-serif]Installation instructions[/font][/size][/color][/i][/b]
[list]
[*]Download and unzip the file.[/*]
[*]Place the extracted folder into your Stardew Valley Mods folder.[/*]
[/list]

Manifest.Description: Secret Woods spring-water collection behavior for More Coffee. Each empty bottle is exchanged for five servings of spring water.
